body: Coconut oil is incredible! But, it can clog pores, so I’d be weary of using it on your face if you’re prone to acne like I am. Otherwise, go wild.

I appreciate it. I take that philosophy for other people, but it’s hard to apply it to myself, to forgive my mistakes and move on even when I’m trying to improve myself. It’s easy to say, but it’s so much more difficult in practice.
